MirrorLine.description: A straight curve's id, or x / y for a sketch axis, or {
} for an origin axis (its projection into the sketch plane; an axis perpendicular to the plane is refused).

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

StringList.description: A name, or a list of names.

input.description:
Mirror sketch curves and points across a line, as new copies, and add symmetry constraints
between each point and its copy (a point on the line stays one point, held on it). Circles
copied are made equal to their originals. One undo step.

entities.description: The curves and points to mirror, by id (one id is taken as a list of one).

sketch.description: The sketch (default: the one being edited).

input.title: MirrorParams

label: Mirror

Created.description: What a command added to its sketch: the ids that the sketch has now and did not before.

constraints.description: Constraint ids, dimensions not among them.

wires.description: The ids of 3D curves, when the command made any.

constraints.description:
The constraints added: symmetry between each point and its copy, equal circles, and a
shared point held on the line.

created.description: Everything the call added to the sketch: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`.

curves.description: The copies of the curves, in order.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

params: entities: [curve/point ids], line: straight curve id, x / y for a sketch axis, or {axis: X|Y|Z} for an origin axis (the mirror line is the axis's projection into the sketch plane; an axis perpendicular to the plane is refused) (symmetry constraints are added). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
